sources.title: Minecraft Profile Lookup — UUID, Skin, Cape & Name History | Java ...
sources.snippet: Minecraft Java Edition UUID Lookup For Java Edition players, enter their current or past username. We return the UUID from our cache when we have it, or fetch from the official Mojang API. UUIDs never change, even when a player changes their username, so they're ideal for server bans, whitelists, and plugins. You get full name history — every username the player has ever used.
